Frequently Asked Questions

Who are Deborah and Chuck Morris? Deborah is our primary listing agent, with a background in interior design and furniture. Chuck is our primary buyer agent, bringing a field-engineer and IT background.

What brokerage are you affiliated with? Deborah Morris Home Team, REALTORS®, is proudly affiliated with Keller Williams Advantage Realty.

What areas do you serve? Seminole County, Orange County, Lake County, Volusia County, and surrounding areas.

How do I get in touch? Call 321-348-0014, email info@DeborahMorrisHomeTeam.com, or use the contact form on our Get in Touch page.

Does your team use AI tools? Yes — AI tools help with code, images, and video, but every listing and piece of advice is reviewed by Deborah or Chuck personally. See our full AI Usage disclosure on the Terms & Conditions page.

What community events do you host? Several throughout the year, from charity drives like our annual Blessing Baskets Thanksgiving program to neighborhood get-togethers like our Ice Cream Social and Pumpkin Painting event.
